subject: Execution plan for Brightwell MSA + Order Form — signer authority & notarization
messages:
From: Julia Martin <julia.martin@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightwellhealth.com, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Execution plan for Brightwell MSA + Order Form — signer authority & notarization

Hi Marcus / Laura —

Thanks again for turning around the redlines quickly. Attached is our finalized signer list and a short table of local requirements per country (Brightwell_Signer_List.xlsx). A few items to highlight from procurement/legal: 

- Our APAC entity in Singapore requires a notarized signature for the Order Form addendum when value > $250k; Brazil office prefers in-person notarization for their regional director.
- Contract needs to be executed as a combined package (MSA + Order Form) in a single envelope where possible to preserve effective dates.
- We will only accept the final clean MSA and Order Form as PDFs attached to the DocuSign envelope; please include evidence of signatory authority (POA or board resolution) if signing is delegated.

Could Redwood confirm: 
1) Whether DocuSign can accommodate a mixed routing plan (electronic sign for US/EU, wet/notarized for SG/BR) and still deliver a single combined executed PDF?
2) Who at Redwood will be the primary contact to coordinate notarization logistics for Brightwell BR/SG signers?
3) Estimated signing window once envelope is issued (we'd like to target the week of Oct 26).

Attaching the signer list now for your intake. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Regards,
Julia Martin
Director, Legal Ops | Brightwell Health
[Attachment: Brightwell_Signer_List.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Julia Martin <julia.martin@brightwellhealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution plan for Brightwell MSA + Order Form — signer authority & notarization

Julia —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and for the signer list. Short answers: yes, we can support the hybrid flow and deliver a single combined executed PDF; we just need to orchestrate a couple of manual steps for the APAC/Brazil notarizations. Below is our proposed plan and owners.

Proposed execution sequencing (single envelope intention):
1) Prepare combined clean copies (MSA + Order Form) and lock in the final signatory names/sequence. 
2) Issue DocuSign envelope with separate routing lanes: 
   - Lane A (electronic): US + EU signers (standard e-sign)
   - Lane B (evidence required): SG signer — we will set the signer as "Needs wet signature / notarization" and include instructions for returning a notarized PDF to redwood.notary@redwood.com within 48h of the envelope issuance.
   - Lane C (local counsel/wet): BR signer — we'll pre-schedule a local notary and provide a signer packet; the final notarized page(s) will be appended to the combined execution binder and the final consolidated PDF will be generated by our operations team.

Owners: 
- Redwood Ops lead for this envelope: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com) — will coordinate notarization vendors and consolidate final PDF.
- Redwood Legal reviewer: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com) — will confirm clause 7.2 and signatory authority language are as agreed.
- Primary contact for Brightwell coordination: Marcus Lin (me) — will coordinate schedule & DocuSign routing.

Open items / asks from Brightwell: 
- Please confirm the exact signatory names and the preferred order for each region (use the attached signer list we received).
- If BR/SG signers will provide POAs or board resolutions, please attach to the envelope or send to redwood.notary@redwood.com.
- Confirm whether Brightwell prefers Redwood to create the envelope (we can) or if you will initiate from your DocuSign system.

Timing: we can prepare clean PDFs today once Laura confirms final redlines; if Brightwell confirms signers by EOD tomorrow we can target the Oct 26 signing window.

Visibility: I will send the clean MSA/Order Form drafts once Laura signs off. Vanessa will handle the notary logistics and final packet assembly.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Julia Martin <julia.martin@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution plan for Brightwell MSA + Order Form — signer authority & notarization

Marcus / Julia —

I've completed legal's pass on the consolidated MSA + Order Form. Summary: 
- All commercial redlines accepted except two narrow edits to the data residency clause and Section 7.2 (indemnity cap carve-out). I've added a short concession for limited liability in the Order Form.
- I have prepared clean PDFs for signature: Redwood_Clean_Copy_MSA.pdf and Redwood_OrderForm_Clean.pdf (attached). These are the versions we will include in the DocuSign envelope.

On notarization: we agree with the sequencing Marcus proposed. For Brazil, local counsel requires the notarized signature to be accompanied by a translated page (we can coordinate translation if Brightwell prefers). For Singapore, a notarized PDF is sufficient. 

Next steps from legal: 
1) Julia — please confirm BR/SG preference on translations and whether Brightwell will provide POA documents.
2) Marcus / Vanessa — please create the envelope and set Lane B/C as "manual completion" with instructions to upload notarized pages to the envelope or send them to redwood.notary@redwood.com for attachment.

I'll be on standby for a noon call tomorrow if you want to walk through the sequencing.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Clean_Copy_MSA.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Redwood_OrderForm_Clean.pdf (PDF)]

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightwellhealth.com>

Marcus —

Thanks to everyone. Brightwell confirms: 
- We will provide POAs for the Brazilian director by Oct 25 and do not require translation for the POA itself (only the notarized signature page if Redwood requires).
- Singapore signer will provide a notarized PDF within 48 hours of envelope issuance.
- Brightwell requests Redwood to create and send the envelope (please include a clear step-by-step signer instruction block for the APAC lanes).

Tom (procurement) will coordinate internal availability; we are aligned on the Oct 26 window. Please proceed and share envelope link once ready.
